<infobox theme="noble">
<title source="name"><default>{{PAGENAME}}</default></title>
<image source="image">
<caption source="caption"/>
</image>
<data source="native_name"><label>Native name</label></data>
<data source="title"><label>Title</label></data>
<data source="more"><label>More titles</label></data>
<group>
<header>{{#if:{{{house|}}}{{{noble_family|}}}{{{dynasty|}}}{{{father|}}}{{{mother|}}}{{{spouse|}}}{{{spouses|}}}{{{partner|}}}{{{partners|}}}{{{children|}}}{{{issue|}}}|Family}}</header>
<data source="house"><label>House</label></data>
<data source="noble_family"><label>Noble family</label></data>
<data source="dynasty"><label>Dynasty</label></data>
<data source="father"><label>Father</label></data>
<data source="mother"><label>Mother</label></data>
<data source="spouse"><label>Spouse</label></data>
<data source="spouses"><label>Spouses</label></data>
<data source="partner"><label>Partner</label></data>
<data source="partners"><label>Partners</label></data>
<data source="children"><label>Children</label></data>
<data source="issue"><label>Issue</label></data>
</group>
<group>
<header>{{#if:{{{birth_name|}}}{{{birth_date|}}}{{{birth_place|}}}{{{death_date|}}}{{{death_place|}}}{{{burial_date|}}}{{{burial_place|}}}|Personal}}</header>
<data source="birth_name"><label>Born</label></data>
<data source="birth_date"><label>Born</label></data>
<data source="birth_place"><label>Birthplace</label></data>
<data source="death_date"><label>Died</label></data>
<data source="death_place"><label>Place of death</label></data>
<data source="burial_date"><label>Buried</label></data>
<data source="burial_place"><label>Burial place</label></data>
<data source="religion"><label>Religion</label></data>
<data source="nationality"><label>Nationality</label></data>
</group>
<group>
<header>{{#if:{{{reign|}}}{{{tenure|}}}{{{predecessor|}}}{{{successor|}}}{{{coronation|}}}{{{succession|}}}|Reign}}</header>
<data source="reign"><label>Reign</label></data>
<data source="tenure"><label>Tenure</label></data>
<data source="succession"><label>Succession</label></data>
<data source="coronation"><label>Coronation</label></data>
<data source="predecessor"><label>Predecessor</label></data>
<data source="successor"><label>Successor</label></data>
<data source="regent"><label>Regent</label></data>
</group>
<data source="occupation"><label>Occupation</label></data>
<data source="signature"><label>Signature</label></data>
</infobox><noinclude>
{{Documentation|content=
;Fandom Portable Infobox replacement for the broken interwiki
"redirect" to enwiki. Covers the parameters used by noble / titled
person articles. Empty rows hide automatically.
}}
[[Category:Infobox templates]]
[[Category:fandom sync]]
[[Category:Fandom Portable Infobox templates]]
[[Category:Independently git synced pages]]
{{wikidata link|Q11493323}}
</noinclude>
